title: Contractor Contact Windows for Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
Contact windows within which the assigned network contractor contacts the requester on a Rental Property Service Contracts service request, in hours, by tier.

| Tier | Routine request | Emergency request |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | 24 hours | 12 hours |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | 48 hours | 24 hours |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | 24 hours | 12 hours |

The two Plus tiers halve both windows: 24 hours on a routine request and 12 hours on an emergency, against 48 and 24 hours on the other four tiers.
